title: Overall Plan (Phase 1)
description: Front-matter schema for `.harness/plans/overview.md` — the single overall plan the planning subagent produces in Phase 1. The main agent presents this file for user review; Phase 2 does not run until this plan is approved.

status.description: Draft while the subagent is iterating with the user; approved (with approvedAt stamped) once the human explicitly says go.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the first-draft generation

approvedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp captured when status flips to approved

request.description: The original user request, restated by the subagent in its own words

featureCount.description: Number of features the overall plan proposes

assumptions.description: Anything the subagent inferred without asking. `confirmed: false` marks unconfirmed assumptions — these require explicit approval before Azure tasks are created (see AGENTS.md Present breakdown).

featureTypes.description: Proposed Conventional Commits type per feature (feat/fix/refactor/…). Keyed by featId. Editable at commit approval.
